news.title: Geri-Action makes its world premiere at the Independent Shorts Awards
news.body:
Geri-Action, Rare Pond's series proof of concept about a retired superspy breaking out of her nursing home, had its world premiere on September 19, 2026 at the Independent Shorts Awards in Los Angeles, screening at Regal LA LIVE as part of a special non-competitive showcase.

The Independent Shorts Awards is an international short film festival and live event series based in Los Angeles. Its 8th annual awards night drew from more than 3,400 submissions, and Geri-Action carries the festival's **Official Selection** laurel for 2026.

Writer-director Jack Carlsen was in the theatre for the first public screening and spent the evening meeting the filmmakers behind the other selections. Getting the film onto a cinema screen also meant finishing a DCP (Digital Cinema Package) from the 4K master, mastered with The DCP Works ahead of the festival's delivery deadline.

Geri-Action mixes live action with animation, the blend of mediums Rare Pond builds every one of its little universes from. The festival run continues from here: follow @geri_action_film for screening announcements, and visit the [Geri-Action page](/geriaction) for stills, credits and the trailer as it lands.

news.title: Rare Pond at the 50th Ottawa International Animation Festival
news.body:
Rare Pond spent the last week of September in Ottawa for the 50th anniversary edition of the Ottawa International Animation Festival (OIAF), September 23 to 27, 2026, where founder Jack Carlsen was interviewed about the studio by the Animation Platform.

OIAF is one of the most important animation festivals in the world, and its 50th edition filled downtown Ottawa with screenings, talks and industry events across the National Arts Centre, the ByTowne Cinema, Arts Court and the Ottawa Art Gallery.

The interview covers how Rare Pond approaches its films, from live action to 2D and 3D animation, and where the studio is headed next. It has not been published yet. This article will be updated with the link as soon as it goes live.

Beyond the interview, the week was about people: a few days of conversations with animators, studios and festival programmers from across the industry, and plenty of new friends of the pond.

news.title: Geri-Action is an Official Selection of Indie Short Fest 2026
news.body:
Geri-Action has been named an **Official Selection of Indie Short Fest 2026**, the film's second festival selection of the year alongside the Independent Shorts Awards.

Indie Short Fest is an international short film festival based in Los Angeles. It runs monthly editions throughout the year, and films selected in a monthly edition qualify for its annual live screening and awards ceremony.

The laurel now sits beside the film's page on this site, next to the Independent Shorts Awards selection. More festival news for Geri-Action is on the way; the [Geri-Action page](/geriaction) always carries the current list.
